run_weighted_boxes_fusion: run weighted boxes fusion to merge bounding box predictions from multiple object detection models
run_prefilter_boxes: run prefilter boxes to filter and organize bounding boxes by score threshold and label
run_get_weighted_box: run get weighted box to compute a weighted average bounding box from a cluster of overlapping boxes
run_find_matching_box_fast: run find matching box fast to locate the best IoU match for a new box among existing boxes
review_weighted_boxes_fusion: review the weighted boxes fusion algorithm supporting avg, max, box_and_model_avg, and absent_model_aware_avg confidence types
